settings.title: Global System Settings & Maintenance

settings.calendarSubtitle: Enter academic weeks and holidays; system automatically deducts holidays to calculate theoretical target progress

settings.bulkMmiDesc: Download standard templates, input planned targets and baseline thresholds per grade/subject, and bulk import into system
settings.productionMaintenanceDesc: Used for clearing historical test data before live launch; supports one-click backup
